about.title: About Me
about.imageCaption: Reply XChange 2026 - GenAI for ITSM Ticket Validation
description: Hi! My name is **Davide Arcolini**, but you can call me `dvdr00t` 🤓!

I am an AI Engineer at [**Liquid Reply**](https://www.reply.com/liquid-reply/en/) specialized in designing and deploying **Multi-Agent Systems**, **RAG Pipelines** and **MCP Integrations** to production environments. I hold a Master of Science in **Computer Engineering** with a focus on cybersecurity from [**Politecnico di Torino**](https://www.polito.it/). Passionate about security, I've participated in programs like [**CyberChallenge.IT**](https://bestr.it/award/show/rLlb917mQk-v6w0rGCpO8Q), led the [**Challenge@PoliTo**](https://bestr.it/award/show/8MiJNQU_R9uGIwqmioc4Uw) with [**Aruba S.p.A**](https://www.aruba.it/academy.aspx), and contributed in leading and presenting tech events for [**IEEE-HKN**](https://hknpolito.org/).

roles.description: As student for the Aruba Academy program, I developed and integrated mobile, desktop and web application access methodologies based on common passwordless access standards created by the FIDO Alliance and the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

roles.title: Master of Science in Computer Engineering (Cybersecurity)
roles.description: During my Master of Science, I competed in CyberChallenge.IT, ranking among the top 20 students in the 2021 program. As a team leader at Challenge@PoliTo with Aruba S.p.A., I worked with my team to develop passwordless access methodologies using FIDO2.0. I also participated in the BIP CyberSec Talent Week and IEEE Eurocon 2023 competitions. Beyond technology, I dedicated more than 230 hours to serving as a teaching assistant and embodied IEEE-HKN principles as a member and young professional. I organized and presented tech events leading the Logistics section of the Mu Nu Chapter at Politecnico di Torino, demonstrating leadership, character, and attitude.
